The '''Emperor's Shadow''' was a space-faring device which included third-generation cloaking technology. It was commissioned by [[Darth Malgus]] and created using the power and materials extracted by the Sun Razer in the Vesla system.

==Description==
The hull of the Emperor's Shadow was black. It had a spherical center with other spheres and arm-like protrusions surrounding it.

==History==
Using the [[Sun Razer]], the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] was able to complete its creation in years instead of decades. All the projects fueled by the Sun Razer were overseen by [[Darth Mekhis]] and discovered by [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] upon their infiltration and capture in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]].
